properties.comment: Consolidated list of all secondary capacity trades which includes GSH trades (screen traded and off-market trades) and Bilateral trades submitted into the GBB

fields.doc: Unique capacity transaction id
fields.name: TRANSACTION_ID

fields.doc: Updated version within transaction id
fields.name: VERSION_DATETIME

fields.doc: The date the trade was made. Disregard the time component as this is not applicable.
fields.name: TRADE_DATE

fields.doc: The effective start date of the trade. Disregard the time component as this is not applicable.
fields.name: FROM_GAS_DATE

fields.doc: The effective end date of the trade. Disregard the time component as this is not applicable.
fields.name: TO_GAS_DATE

fields.doc: The type of trade
fields.name: TRADE_TYPE

fields.doc: The unique identifier of the Part 24 facility. Mandatory for facilities registered under Part 24 of the rules.
fields.name: FACILITY_ID

fields.doc: The descriptive name of the facility.
fields.name: FACILITY_NAME

fields.doc: The transportation service type
fields.name: TRANSPORTATION_SERVICE_TYPE

fields.doc: The direction of the flow for non-Part 24 facilities, relative to the general physical direction of the facility. Valid values are:NORTHNORTH_EASTNORTH_WESTEASTSOUTH_EASTSOUTHSOUTH_WESTWEST
fields.name: FLOW_DIRECTION

fields.doc: The unique identifier of the Part 24 Receipt Zone. This is the zone in which the receipt point that was reported to AEMO is specified. Mandatory for service points registered under Part 24 of the rules.
fields.name: RECEIPT_ZONE_ID

fields.doc: The descriptive name of the Receipt Zone.
fields.name: RECEIPT_ZONE_NAME

fields.doc: The unique identifier of the Part 24 Delivery Zone. This is the zone in which the delivery point that was reported to AEMO is specified. Mandatory for service points registered under Part 24 of the rules.
fields.name: DELIVERY_ZONE_ID

fields.doc: The descriptive name of the Delivery Zone.
fields.name: DELIVERY_ZONE_NAME

fields.doc: The descriptive name of the service point.
fields.name: PARK_LOAN_POINT_NAME

fields.doc: Flag to indicate whether a standard OTSA was used
fields.name: STANDARD_OTSA

fields.doc: The priority of the traded capacity. Mandatory for GBB bilateral trades. Null for GSH trades.
fields.name: PRIORITY

fields.doc: The traded maximum daily quantity (MDQ) (GJ/day).
fields.name: MAX_DAILY_QUANTITY

fields.doc: The traded maximum hourly quantity (GJ/hour). Null for GSH trades.
fields.name: MAX_HOURLY_QUANTITY

fields.doc: The price of the traded capacity ($/GJ/day).
fields.name: PRICE

fields.doc: The price structure applied over the term of the trade. Mandatory for GBB bilateral trades. Null for GSH trades.
fields.name: PRICE_STRUCTURE

fields.doc: The price escalation mechanism applied over the term of the trade. Null for GSH trades.
fields.name: PRICE_ESCALATION_MECHANISM

fields.doc: The date and time the report was generated.
fields.name: LASTCHANGED
